exposure: Breast stimulation program using a breast pump shortly after cesarean section (CS)
Providing information about breastfeeding after CS
Breast pump-mediated nipple stimulation (within 6 h postpartum, continuing until day 2, at least four times daily)
outcome: Feasibility of the program (acceptability, practicality, implementation)
cohort: The study participants included full-term women who underwent planned Cesarean section at a regional perinatal hospital and nurse-midwives.
finding: The breast stimulation program initiated shortly after Cesarean section was deemed feasible, well accepted by women, and showed positive aspects regarding early breast milk volume.
mod_finding: The breast stimulation program for women who underwent Cesarean section was feasible and well accepted, suggesting a potential benefit for early lactogenesis in this population.
